name: spin-band-punch
description: Sustained-spin check for the 180 rad/s handoff era: 0.5 A through capture + confirmed handoff (~1.3 s), then a 1.5 A punch to blast through the omega_e 400-800 L(f) band fast (slow band transit is the 6/6 OC reproducer; fast transit was historically clean), then the standard 0.3 A cruise at the no-load ceiling, unload at 8.
